_readme: Editorial metadata + declared chapter structure for the career-guidance library.
Chapter structure is DECLARED here rather than detected, because the ten source
documents were hand-authored over years and their Word outline levels are not
semantically usable (New DOCX Document.docx puts real chapters and 'Quick Facts'
both at heading 1; career guidance after class 10.docx marks chapters with
heading 2 and SUBsections with heading 1; commerce.docx numbers chapters 4-9 but
not 1-3). Run the command with --propose to regenerate a first-draft chapter list
for a document, then check the corrected list in here.
chapter_titles entries are either a verbatim heading string, or
{match, title} when the source has no chapter-level heading at all and the
chapter has to be opened on its first subsection.
'stage' drives the Library filter chips; 'stage_order' their display order.
'legacy_slugs' keeps already-published URLs alive after a slug change.
